data.title: ClipMaster Pro
data.description: ClipMaster Pro is a fast, production-ready desktop clipboard manager for Windows. Built with Electron, React, and TypeScript, it features instant clipboard monitoring backed by a native C# background listener. Designed with premium UI aesthetics, it offers a quick-expand detail viewer dialog, timeline categorization, keyboard navigation shortcuts, color-coded tagging, and local atomic file persistence with auto-.bak recovery for crash resilience.

featuresList.title: Auto-Capture & Privacy
featuresList.description: Instant clipboard monitoring with quick-pause options (15 mins, 30 mins, 1 hour, or until restart) for private copying sessions.

featuresList.title: Ctrl+Shift+V Clipboard History Popup
featuresList.description: Instantly summons a fast-access clipboard history popup window directly at your cursor position using the global Ctrl+Shift+V keyboard shortcut.

featuresList.title: Bulk Actions
featuresList.description: Allows selecting multiple items at once to perform batch operations like multi-delete, bulk tag updates, or mass restores.

featuresList.title: Import & Export Wizard
featuresList.description: Enables exporting selected clips or entire history logs into Excel (.xlsx), JSON, or text (.txt) formats, and importing backups back into the database.

featuresList.title: Native Version Switcher
featuresList.description: Allows switching between historical versions and installing updates directly from settings using native batch/shell script overwrites.

featuresList.title: Smart Search & Pagination
featuresList.description: Fast clipboard history search with real-time result highlighting and responsive page-by-page rendering.

featuresList.title: Advanced Tags & Favourites
featuresList.description: Color-coded tags, tag filters, and a dedicated Favourites page to easily categorize and isolate important clips.

featuresList.title: Premium UI & Shortcuts
featuresList.description: Modern interface featuring a quick-expand detail viewer dialog, system tray controls, and keyboard shortcuts (e.g. Ctrl + Delete to bypass recycle bin).

featuresList.title: Hardened Persistence
featuresList.description: Crash-resilient atomic 'write-then-rename' file operations with automatic .bak recovery to prevent settings reset on forced shutdowns.

data.title: BlogByte Blog
data.shortDescription: A modern, full-stack blogging platform built with the MERN stack featuring rich text editing, secure authentication, user comments, and Cloudinary media uploads.
data.description: BlogByte Blog is a robust and responsive blogging application developed using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js. It features a complete MVC architecture, JWT-based user authentication, and seamless integration with Cloudinary for fast and reliable image hosting. Users can search and filter posts, write blogs using a Jodit Rich Text Editor, like articles, and comment on them. An administrative dashboard offers controls for managing users, comments, and posts, ensuring full content moderation capability.

data.title: Listing Hub
data.shortDescription: A full-stack MVC web application for listing and discovering unique accommodations and destinations worldwide.
data.description: Listing-Hub (originally Wanderlust) is a robust, full-stack MVC web application designed to allow users to discover, list, and review unique accommodations. data.title: Parsec Classic
data.shortDescription: A beautiful and powerful system utility platform featuring a file explorer, file compression, sharing, remote control, and media/document tools.
data.description:
Parsec Classic is an all-in-one system utility and media processing platform designed to run in modern environments. It brings professional-grade file systems, archiving tools, document manipulation, media encoders, file sharing, and remote screen control under a single dashboard. Developed with a high-fidelity dark glassmorphic interface, it offers rich micro-animations, dynamic accent shifts, and seamless WebRTC sessions for real-time collaboration. The project utilizes a robust Node.js, Express, and Socket.IO backend paired with a React and TailwindCSS frontend to ensure speed, security, and fluid usability.

Note: This project is currently in an early development phase. The frontend user interface and core backend structures are partially implemented but not yet fully functional.

data.title: Parsec Modern
data.shortDescription: An all-in-one system utility platform for file management, media processing, screen capture, and secure file sharing, built as a web application.
data.description:
Parsec Modern is an all-in-one system utility platform designed to run entirely in the browser. It offers a suite of tools including file management, media processing, screen capture, and secure file sharing. By leveraging browser-based APIs like the Canvas API, MediaDevices API, and running heavy tasks like ffmpeg via WebAssembly (ffmpeg.wasm) directly on the client side, Parsec provides a powerful desktop-like experience without the need for server-side processing.

Note: This project is currently in an early development phase. The frontend user interface and core backend structures are partially implemented but not yet fully functional.

featuresList.title: File Explorer & Management
featuresList.description: Browse, upload, download, and delete user files directly from/to Firebase Storage with seamless integration.

featuresList.title: Image Processing Tools
featuresList.description: Perform image operations like resizing, cropping, converting formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP), and upscaling using the browser's native Canvas API.

featuresList.title: Client-Side Video Editing
featuresList.description: Crop, compress, and convert video formats, plus extract thumbnails directly inside the browser using WebAssembly-powered ffmpeg.wasm.

featuresList.title: Client-Side Audio Processing
featuresList.description: Normalize loudness to EBU R128 standards, apply bass boost, add 8D audio effects, trim, and strip metadata using ffmpeg.wasm.

featuresList.title: Document Compression & Conversion
featuresList.description: Lock/unlock PDF files, rearrange pages, compress PDFs, and convert DOCX to PDF using client-side pdf-lib and mammoth.js.

featuresList.title: Screen Control & Recording
featuresList.description: Capture screenshots and record screen activities (including audio) utilizing the browser's native MediaDevices API, then automatically save recordings to Firebase Storage.

featuresList.title: Secure File Sharing
featuresList.description: Generate tokenized public share links with configurable download limits and expiration times, managed via Cloud Firestore.

featuresList.title: Adaptive Custom Theme

data.title: Media Control Toolkit
data.shortDescription: A premium Manifest V3 Chrome extension offering 10x volume boost, YouTube ad forwarder, speed controls, smart scrolling, media scanning, and privacy analytics.
data.description:
The Media Control Toolkit is a powerful and versatile browser extension built on Chrome Extension Manifest V3. It provides users with advanced controls over media playback, page scrolling, and privacy auditing. The features include a volume booster powered by the Web Audio API (up to 10x gain), dynamic playback rate controllers, smart scrolling controls, a page-wide media content scanner and downloader, an automated YouTube ad skipper, and detailed cookie auditing and privacy metrics dashboards.

Note: The extension is fully functional, though minor bugs still exist. Full compatibility and fixes will be rolled out in future releases.

featuresList.description: Automated monitoring that mutes, speeds up, or clicks the skip button on YouTube ads, restoring normal video speed and volume settings post-ad.
